messages:
maria: Heads-up — CS just escalated HQFin embeddings errors in prod. They report p95 latency spikes and 5xxs since 03:00 UTC. SLA window at risk if not mitigated within 8h. Who can own triage?

alex: I'm on call, looking now. initial glance at metrics shows elevated KV cache misses and multiple OOMs on pool-3 nodes.

maria: CS suggests workaround (route to smaller embed model) but that will increase token usage. Need quick mitigation + customer-facing ETA.

alex: Running a few checks. current plan: try increasing HPA maxReplicas and evict stale KV entries to drop memory pressure. If that fails, divert 5% traffic to fallback model.

jonathan: I'll prepare the fallback canary and rollout plan. If we need to rollback or divert, I'll own the traffic shift and the post-change validation.

sri: I'll open a runbook PR to add explicit cache eviction steps and a healthcheck for memory growth. Quick heads-up: infra-steering signoff required for prod HPA changes.

alex: Commands I'm running (for visibility):
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=pool-3 --since=15m | grep -i oom
kubectl get hpa pool-3 -o yaml
kubectl patch hpa pool-3 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":10}}'
```

maria: CS needs an ETA to pass to customer. Can we commit to 2h for temporary mitigation (autoscale + cache eviction) and 6h for full root-cause + durable fix?

alex: 2h for mitigation is realistic if infra approves the HPA bump quickly. 6h for a thorough RC and clean deployment seems fair.

jonathan: I'll draft the customer update now with both options (mitigation + fallback). @sri can you review runbook PR once it's up?

sri: PR posted, small change. Also pinged @infra-steering for emergency approval; noted impact and rollback steps.

infra-steering: acknowledged. Please include expected CPU/memory delta in the approval thread. We will fast-track but need those numbers.

alex: Added metrics snapshot to the approval thread. patching HPA now pending approval.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1134. Pager alerted to on-call.

maria: Thanks team. I'll tell CS: 2h mitigation ETA (autoscale + eviction) contingent on infra OK; full RCA and fix within 6h.

jonathan: After we stabilize, propose a 30m sync with CS + eng-platform tomorrow 11:00 to review root cause and long-term mitigations.

maria: Agreed. I'll schedule and include meeting notes template. :thumbsup:

alex: quick note — if HPA change doesn't hold, next step is draining the most memory-heavy nodes and forcing a rolling replace (non-disruptive for cached sessions). I'll prepare the playbook.

sri: Added eviction script snippet to PR for immediate use.

maria: Great. Please update this thread as you make changes so CS has live info. Closing for now, will reopen if mitigation fails.
